tool.name: read_log_tail
tool.description: Read the last N lines from a log file or journalctl. Useful for checking recent errors or activity.

when_to_use.trigger: User asks about recent log entries
User wants to see errors in a log file
User asks to check system logs

parameters.param: Path to log file (e.g., '/var/log/syslog', '/var/log/nginx/error.log'). Use 'journalctl' for systemd journal. SECURITY: Only /var/log paths are allowed.
Number of lines to read (default: 20, max: 100)
Optional grep filter to match specific patterns (e.g., 'error', 'failed')

safety_rules.rule: Only /var/log paths are allowed for security
Maximum 100 lines to prevent overwhelming output
journalctl access allowed for systemd logs

example.input: Check for errors in nginx log
